name: Jinan Wildlife World (济南野生动物世界)
verdict: Jinan Wildlife World is a park managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, which lists Jinan Wildlife World Co., Ltd. among its investments; the group is 93.19% held and controlled by the Jinan municipal SASAC. Back-of-shirt sponsor of Shandong Taishan for the 2026 CSL season.

why.text: Jinan Wildlife World, advertised on the back of the shirt, is managed and operated by Jinan Culture & Tourism Development Group, whose largest shareholder and actual controller (93.19%) is the Jinan municipal state-assets commission. The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations were committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. So the money behind the back of the shirt is the Chinese state's.
why.messageLine: The UN human rights office found that China’s large-scale arbitrary detention of Uyghurs in Xinjiang may amount to crimes against humanity.

note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Shandong Taishan in the 2026 Chinese Super League season (named press: Tencent News / 九五体育, 2026-03-17).
